4K, 1/2.8-inch Sony CMOS 8.5MP, 12x. HFOV explicitly labeled Horizontal on datasheet (6.5 tele to 70.9 wide); this HFOV is the render value. Focal length 3.5 to 42mm (±5%) from Minrray support mail for the UV420B2 output variant, which shares the base 12x optics (42/3.5 = 12x, and back-solving 3.5 and 42mm on the 5.14mm sensor width gives 72.6 and 7.0 degrees, consistent with the datasheet HFOV). The mail's rounded FOV of 8 to 80 degrees is nominal for the B2 variant and is not used as the render value (POS-D01, published datasheet HFOV is authoritative). AI real-time + zone tracking. minrraycam.com/ultra-hd-4k-ptz-camera-uv420.html. Current.

4K broadcasting PTZ, 1/1.8-inch 8.42MP CMOS, 12x. FOV labeled 'Viewing Angle'; Tier-1 datasheet confirms HORIZONTAL (20X 59.4 and 31X 60.0 match geometric H within ~1.5 deg, 5+ deg from diagonal; 12X 82.1 is a generous published H, POS-D01). Staged as HFOV, no conversion (Kay 2026-08-10). FreeD output; NDI|HX and Dante AV optional; Tally light; three IR receivers. Part of UV470 family. Current.

FHD live PTZ, 1/2.8-inch 2.07MP, 12x, f=3.9-46.8 (View Angle 72.5 W / 6.3 T). Horizontal/vertical screen switching.
